string-array.name: release_notes
string-array.item: Search has a new look: the search bar sits at the bottom, under your thumb, on frosted glass over your results. A filter button beside it shows where you are; press it and slide to apps, people, events or files, or tap it to leave the choices open.

Type what you want done: \"timer 10m\", \"alarm 7:30\", \"call Mom\", \"text Sam\", \"email Priya\", \"maps coffee\" or \"event Lunch with Sam\", then press Go. Timers and alarms are set without opening the clock, and \"alarm off\" and \"timer stop\" are there for when plans change. Each row says which app it will open.
Calendar events turn up in search, with an Events tab for what\'s coming up. Hold one to join its video call or get directions.
Hints beside the result count show how to finish a command as you type it, and Search tips in settings lists everything search can do, with examples to try.
Permissions are only asked for when you tap to allow them, from the tab that needs them.
App backups, caches and the trash are always left out of file search, so the \"Reduce index size\" setting is gone.
